feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 13 October 2026 7:28am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 13 October 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Frontal trough will continue to affect the east of the British Isles, with a strong west to southwest airstream following for the Irish Sea area.


##Wind##

West or Southwest 5 or 6 occasionally 7 this morning and afternoon. West 5 or 6 this evening, then decreasing Southwest 4 or 5 at first tonight, then backing South or Southwest 5 or 6 later in night.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming moderate later today.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southwest 5 or 6, increasing 6 or 7 tomorrow morning, then occasionally gale 8 later in day. Little change overnight into Thursday.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, building moderate or rough.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain later.
